verses.sloka: तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोत्थितमरिन्दमम् ।अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयं पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः ।। ६.१२४.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ rātrimuṣitaṁ rāmaṁ sukhotthitamarindamam ।abravīt prāñjalirvākyaṁ jayaṁ pṛṣṭvā vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.124.1 ।।

translations.english: Rising in the morning after comfortable rest that night, Vibheeshana saw Rama the subduer of enemies, offered salutations and asked him of the victory and spoke.
translations.hindi: सप्तदशोत्तशततमः सर्ग; a क्य स उवाच महाप्राज्ञमभिगम्य पुवडूमः । रामं वचनमथज्ञो बरं सर्वधनुष्मताम

verses.sloka: स्नानानि चाङ्गरागाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च ।चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि माल्यानि विविधानि च ।। ६.१२४.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: snānāni cāṅgarāgāṇi vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।candanāni ca divyāni mālyāni vividhāni ca ।। 6.124.2 ।।

translations.english: These lotus petal eyed women well versed in decoration are at your service. They are willing to assist you in bath. There are cosmetics for anointing your body, and clothes as well as ornaments, sandal paste etc. for you. There are garlands of several types here.
translations.hindi: हे अभो जिनके लिए यह इतना विशाल आयोजन किया गया ( अथात्‌ समुद्र पर पुल बाँधा गया और जान पर खेल कर युद्ध किआ गया ) और जा इस समस्त आयोजन का फल स्वरूप हैं, उन शोकपीड़ित सोता देवी को अब दर्शन देना ठुमको उचित है

verses.sloka: अलङ्कारविदश्चेमा नार्यः पद्मनिभेक्षणाः ।उपस्थितास्त्वां विधिवत् स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव ।प्रतिगृह्णीष्व तत् सर्वं मदनुग्रहकाम्यया ।। ६.१२४.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: alaṅkāravidaścemā nāryaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇāḥ ।upasthitāstvāṁ vidhivat snāpayiṣyanti rāghava ।pratigṛhṇīṣva tat sarvaṁ madanugrahakāmyayā ।। 6.124.3 ।।

translations.english: These lotus petal eyed women well versed in decoration are at your service. They are willing to assist you in bath. There are cosmetics for anointing your body, and clothes as well as ornaments, sandal paste etc. for you. There are garlands of several types here.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि शोक से विकल रोती हुई जानको तुम्हारे विजय का. संबाद सुनते ही हर्षित हो गई

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच विभीषमम् ।। ६.१२४.४ ।।ां विधिवत् स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव ।हरीन् सुग्रीवमुख्यांस्त्वं स्नानेनाभिनिमन्त्रय ।। ६.१२४.५ ।।िधिवत् स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव ।स तु ताम्यति धर्मात्मा मम हेतोः सुखोचितः ।सुकुमारो महाबाहुः कुमारः सत्यसंश्रवः ।। ६.१२४.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu kākutsthaḥ pratyuvāca vibhīṣamam ।। 6.124.4 ।।āṁ vidhivat snāpayiṣyanti rāghava ।harīn sugrīvamukhyāṁstvaṁ snānenābhinimantraya ।। 6.124.5 ।।idhivat snāpayiṣyanti rāghava ।sa tu tāmyati dharmātmā mama hetoḥ sukhocitaḥ ।sukumāro mahābāhuḥ kumāraḥ satyasaṁśravaḥ ।। 6.124.6 ।।

translations.english: When Vibheeshana had spoken like that, Kakuthsa Rama replied 'you and monkeys headed by Sugriva bathe and come.'
translations.hindi: पूर्वकालीन परिचय होने के कारण, सीता जी ने मुझ पर विश्वास किआ ओरं यही कहा कि, में उन पणंक्राम ( पूर्ण मनोरथ ) अपने पति को लक्ष्मण सहित, देखना चाहती हूँ

verses.sloka: तं विना केकयीपुत्रं भरतं धर्मचारिणम् ।न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च ।। ६.१२४.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ vinā kekayīputraṁ bharataṁ dharmacāriṇam ।na me snānaṁ bahumataṁ vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।। 6.124.7 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty armed Bharata, righteous, giving up comforts of delicate body, resorting to truth is distressed for my cause."

verses.sloka: इत एव पथा क्षिप्रं प्रतिगच्छामि तां पुरीम् ।अयोध्यामागतो ह्येष पन्थाः परमदुर्गमः ।। ६.१२४.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ita eva pathā kṣipraṁ pratigacchāmi tāṁ purīm ।ayodhyāmāgato hyeṣa panthāḥ paramadurgamaḥ ।। 6.124.8 ।।

translations.english: "When the virtuous Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, is not here, why do I need bath, why so many clothes and ornaments?"
translations.hindi: दीर्घमुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य मेदिनीमवलोकथन | लाच. मेपप डा, (वि पपा मपस्थितस, )॥ 80), Initiative १२४८ युद्धकाण्डे फिर लंबी साँस ले वे रिच को प्रथेची को निहार कर, मेघ के समान विशालकाय विभीषण से, जो वहीं उपस्थित थे, बोले

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.१२४.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu kākutsthaṁ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.124.9 ।।

translations.english: " As it is very difficult to return to that city, think of the path to depart."

verses.sloka: अह्ना त्वां प्रापयिष्यामि तां पुरीं पार्थिवात्मज ।पुष्पकं नाम भद्रं ते विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम् ।। ६.१२४.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: ahnā tvāṁ prāpayiṣyāmi tāṁ purīṁ pārthivātmaja ।puṣpakaṁ nāma bhadraṁ te vimānaṁ sūryasannibham ।। 6.124.10 ।।

translations.english: When Rama had spoken in the aforesaid manner, Vibheeshana replied" O son of the ruler of the earth! I will make you reach Ayodhya in a day."
translations.hindi: जब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने यह कहा, तब विभीष न्त 5 oo र कहा, ण॒ तुरन्त अपने अन्तःपुर में गए और अपनी खियों द्वारा सीता जी से यह सन्देश कहलाया ( और फिर स्त्रयं उनके पास जा बोले )

verses.sloka: मम भ्रातुः कुबेरस्य रावणेनाहृतं बलात् ।हृतं निर्जित्य सङ्ग्रामे कामगं दिव्यमुत्तमम् ।। ६.१२४.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: mama bhrātuḥ kuberasya rāvaṇenāhṛtaṁ balāt ।hṛtaṁ nirjitya saṅgrāme kāmagaṁ divyamuttamam ।। 6.124.11 ।।

translations.english: " An aerial car called Pushpaka, a wonderful one, which closely resembles the sun, which goes according to the will of the rider has been retained with me. It was earned by Ravana from my brother Kubera in a combat. Be auspicious. O Rama, of unequal prowess, this is retained for your cause."

verses.sloka: त्वदर्थे पालितं चैतत्तिष्ठत्यतुलविक्रम ।तदिदं मेघसङ्काशं विमानमिह तिष्ठति ।। ६.१२४.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvadarthe pālitaṁ caitattiṣṭhatyatulavikrama ।tadidaṁ meghasaṅkāśaṁ vimānamiha tiṣṭhati ।। 6.124.12 ।।

translations.english: " An aerial car called Pushpaka, a wonderful one, which closely resembles the sun, which goes according to the will of the rider has been retained with me. It was earned by Ravana from my brother Kubera in a combat. Be auspicious. O Rama, of unequal prowess, this is retained for your cause."
translations.hindi: विभीषण के इस प्रक हे राक्षसेश्‍वर ! मैं तो वि चाहती हूँ

verses.sloka: तेन यास्यसि यानेन त्वमयोध्यां गतज्वरः ।। ६.१२४.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena yāsyasi yānena tvamayodhyāṁ gatajvaraḥ ।। 6.124.13 ।।

translations.english: "This aerial car which waits here which resembles a cloud, will take you to Ayodhya. Be fearless."
translations.hindi: सीता जी के इस कथन को सुन विभोषण ने कहा--( मेरी समम में तो ) जैसा आपके स्वामी महाराज ने आज्ञा दो है आपको तदनुसार ही करना चाहिए

verses.sloka: अहं ते यद्यनुग्राह्यो यदि स्मरसि मे गुणान् ।। ६.१२४.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ te yadyanugrāhyo yadi smarasi me guṇān ।। 6.124.14 ।।

translations.english: "O Wise Rama! If you permit me, and think kindly of me and remember me, and if you have affection for me stay here for a while."

verses.sloka: वस तावदिह प्राज्ञ यद्यस्ति मयि सौहृदभ् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या चापि भार्यया ।। ६.१२४.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vasa tāvadiha prājña yadyasti mayi sauhṛdabh ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā cāpi bhāryayā ।। 6.124.15 ।।

translations.english: "Rama, if all your requirements are met and you are satisfied, then you can start with your brother Lakshmana and wife Vaidehi."
translations.hindi: तब विभीषण ने अपनी स्त्रियों द्वारा सीता जी को सिर से स्नान करवाए ओर भूषणों से भूषित करवाया । बहुमूल्य गहने धारण किए हुए तथा बहुमूल्य वस्न पहिने हुए जानकी को ( विभीषण ने )

verses.sloka: अर्चितः सर्वकामैस्त्वं ततो राम गमिष्यसि ।प्रीतियुक्तस्य मे राम ससैन्यः ससुहृद्गणः ।। ६.१२४.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: arcitaḥ sarvakāmaistvaṁ tato rāma gamiṣyasi ।prītiyuktasya me rāma sasainyaḥ sasuhṛdgaṇaḥ ।। 6.124.16 ।।

translations.english: "Rama, you should accept this hospitality from me at this one occasion, which has been arranged with affection to the army and host of friends."
translations.hindi: एक चसचमाती पालकी में जिस पर बड़ा बढ़िया उघार पड़ा , हुआ था, सवार करवाया। फिर उस पालकी की रक्षा के लिए बहुत से राक्षसों के नियुक्त कर, पालकी को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के निकट लिवा ले चले

verses.sloka: सत्क्रियां विहितां तावद्गृहाण त्वं मयोद्यताम् ।प्रणयाद्वहुमानाच्च सौहृदेन च राघव ।प्रसादयामि प्रेष्यो ऽहं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि ते ।। ६.१२४.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: satkriyāṁ vihitāṁ tāvadgṛhāṇa tvaṁ mayodyatām ।praṇayādvahumānācca sauhṛdena ca rāghava ।prasādayāmi preṣyo 'haṁ na khalvājñāpayāmi te ।। 6.124.17 ।।

translations.english: "I request you out of my high esteem towards you and friendliness. I am your servant and not commanding you to do so."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्ततो रामः प्रत्युवाच विभिषणम् ।रक्षसां वानराणां च सर्वेषां चोपशृण्वताम् ।। ६.१२४.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastato rāmaḥ pratyuvāca vibhiṣaṇam ।rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ copaśṛṇvatām ।। 6.124.18 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Vibheeshana spoken in the aforesaid manner, Rama replied to the hearing of Rakshasas, Vanaras and all of them there.
translations.hindi: श्वर ! हे सौम्य ! सदा हमारे ˆ (र | वजय में रत रहने वाले मित्र ! जानई शीघ्र मेरे पास आवें व क स तचनमाङ्ञाय राघवस्य विभीषणः | यतरे यत्नं कारयामास सर्वतः

verses.sloka: पूजितो ऽहं त्वया सौम्य साचिव्येन परन्तप ।सर्वात्मना च चेष्टाभिः सौहृदेनोत्तमेन च ।। ६.१२४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: pūjito 'haṁ tvayā saumya sācivyena parantapa ।sarvātmanā ca ceṣṭābhiḥ sauhṛdenottamena ca ।। 6.124.19 ।।

translations.english: "O tormentor of enemies! Hero, I am honoured by your friendship, by your efforts, and good heartedness of all of you."
translations.hindi: i आई हुईं सीता को देख, उनके विषय में सोच विचार र, विभीषण से श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने अप्रसन्न हो, यह कहा

verses.sloka: न खल्वेतन्न कुर्यां ते वचनं राक्षसेश्वर ।तं तु मे भ्रातरं द्रष्टुं भरतं त्वरते मनः ।मां निवर्तयितुं यो ऽसौ चित्रकूटमुपागतः ।। ६.१२४.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: na khalvetanna kuryāṁ te vacanaṁ rākṣaseśvara ।taṁ tu me bhrātaraṁ draṣṭuṁ bharataṁ tvarate manaḥ ।māṁ nivartayituṁ yo 'sau citrakūṭamupāgataḥ ।। 6.124.20 ।।

translations.english: "Ruler of Rakshasas! Not accepting your request will surely not happen. (but) my mind is hastening to see my brother Bharata."

verses.sloka: शिरसा याचतो यस्य वचनं न कृतं मया ।। ६.१२४.२१ ।।तु मे भ्रातरं द्रष्टुं भरतं त्वरते मनः ।कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् ।गुरूंश्च सुहृदश्चैव पौरांश्च तनयैः सह ।। ६.१२४.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: śirasā yācato yasya vacanaṁ na kṛtaṁ mayā ।। 6.124.21 ।।tu me bhrātaraṁ draṣṭuṁ bharataṁ tvarate manaḥ ।kausalyāṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca kaikeyīṁ ca yaśasvinīm ।gurūṁśca suhṛdaścaiva paurāṁśca tanayaiḥ saha ।। 6.124.22 ।।

translations.english: "He came to Chitrakuta and on reaching bent down obediently, begged me by his words to return which I did not do. Kausalya, Sumithra and Kaikeyi and Guha also requested and the request of the citizens has been turned down.

verses.sloka: उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर ।कृतकार्यस्य मे वासः कथं स्यादिह सम्मतः ।। ६.१२४.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: upasthāpaya me kṣipraṁ vimānaṁ rākṣaseśvara ।kṛtakāryasya me vāsaḥ kathaṁ syādiha sammataḥ ।। 6.124.23 ।।

translations.english: "He came to Chitrakuta and on reaching bent down obediently, begged me by his words to return which I did not do. Kausalya, Sumithra and Kaikeyi and Guha also requested and the request of the citizens has been turned down.
translations.hindi: जामा पगड़ी पहिने हुए खोजे, जो हाथों में वेत लिये हुए थे चारों ओर घूम घूम कर पुरुषों को हटाने लगे

verses.sloka: अनुजानीहि मां सौम्य पूजितो ऽस्मि विभीषण ।मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यस्त्वरितं त्वा ऽनुमानये ।। ६.१२४.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: anujānīhi māṁ saumya pūjito 'smi vibhīṣaṇa ।manyurna khalu kartavyastvaritaṁ tvā 'numānaye ।। 6.124.24 ।।

translations.english: Noble Vibheeshana! Please permit me to go. I am honoured by you, my friend. Do not be angry or feel sorry. Let me do my duty."
translations.hindi: तब रीछों वानरों ओर रात्तसों के समस्त दल वहां से हटाए जाने पर, दूर जा खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः ।तं विमानं समादाय तूर्णं प्रतिनिवर्तत ।। ६.१२४.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।taṁ vimānaṁ samādāya tūrṇaṁ pratinivartata ।। 6.124.25 ।।

translations.english: "O Ruler of Rakshasas, send for my aerial car. My task has been completed here. How can I continue to stay here?"
translations.hindi: उन सब के हटाने में बैसा ही बड़ा होहल्ला मचा ; जैसा कि बायु के वेग से समुद्र का शब्द होता है

verses.sloka: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं वैडूर्यमयवेदिकम् ।कूटागारैः परिक्षिप्तं सर्वतो रजतप्रभम् ।। ६.१२४.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaṁ vaiḍūryamayavedikam ।kūṭāgāraiḥ parikṣiptaṁ sarvato rajataprabham ।। 6.124.26 ।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken that way, Vibheeshana the king of Rakshasas, hurriedly ordered for the aerial car. The aerial car Pushpaka's parts were decorated with golden pictures, its altars were made of cat's eye gems, its squares were fixed with pillars and shone like silver. It was surrounded on all sides with yellow pennons. It had posts and flags all over, decorated with golden lotuses. The mansions in Pushpak had networks scattered with eyeholes set with pearls like windows. It had rows of bells, surrounded on all sides which had sweet sound. The Pushpak constructed by Viswakarma was huge like mountain Meru's peak and decorated with silver and pearls. Its pavements were fixed with crystals and encrusted with cat's eye gems. The seats were excellent and had rich coverings.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार उन समस्त रीछों, बानरों और राक्षसों का बल पूर्वेक वहाँ से हटाया जाना देख तथा उन सब को घबड़ाया हुआ देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के मन में उनके प्रति दया उत्पन्न हुई। विभीषण ने यह काम श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से आज्ञा लिए बिना ही . , किआ था, अतएव श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को उनका यह काम अच्छा न लगा । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने विभीषण के ऐसा करने से बजा
